{{dablink|For other uses of the word "spring," see [[Spring]].}}
'''Ionin Spring''' is a village in [[Altara]].

When [[Egwene al'Vere]] enters ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' physically to travel to [[Salidar]], she passes through Ionin Spring. She identifies the village's name by the [[Ionin Spring Inn]].{{ref/book|6|34}}
